name: Minimalist fashion
summary: The plain, quiet dress of the 1990s. It has clean lines, fine cloth in grey, black and white, no logo and no trim, and a cut that does all the work.

philosophy.core_thesis: After the show of the 1980s, dress is plain: a perfect cut in fine cloth needs no ornament.
design_principles: Cut each piece with as few seams as the body allows.
Remove each trim, logo, pocket flap and extra button that has no use.
Choose fine, dense cloth in wool, silk crepe, poplin and cashmere.
Keep the palette to black, white, grey, navy and camel.
Cut a straight, long line: a slim trouser, a long jacket and a column dress.
Hide the seam and the facing, and finish the inside as clean as the outside.
Keep the shoulder natural, with no pad.

silhouette.shape: A narrow, straight column: a slim trouser, a long, lean jacket and a simple shift or slip dress.
silhouette.line: A natural shoulder, a straight body with no waist, and a long vertical line.
silhouette.fit: Close but easy; the cloth follows the body without a cling and has no extra fabric.
silhouette.proportion: Jacket to mid-thigh; trouser leg 18 to 20 cm at the hem; lapel 6 to 7 cm; dress hem at the knee or the ankle.
rules: Cut a narrow lapel or none.
Keep the trouser slim and the hem clean.
Remove the pocket flap and sew the pocket inside the seam.
Use one cloth and one colour for the whole outfit.
Finish with a plain flat shoe or a slim sandal.

fabrics.rule: Choose a fine, plain cloth with a clean surface: wool crepe, poplin, silk crepe and a fine knit, with no pattern.

construction.closures: A hidden zip or hook, or one flat button; a coat with a hidden placket.
construction.details: No visible pocket flap, a narrow collar or none, a clean hem and a plain, flat button.

surface.pattern: Plain colour only; a very fine weave or a rib is the only texture.
surface.gloss: Wool and crepe at 2–6 GU; poplin at 10–25 GU; silk at 20–40 GU.
surface.wear: The style wants a clean, new surface; a crease or a mark shows at once.

palette.strategy: A near-neutral set: black, white, grey, navy and camel, with a pale tint at most.

processes: fine tailoring with clean inside finish
making.scale: Designer ready-to-wear in Italy and Germany; each piece made in a good factory with a high standard of finish.
making.signs: A clean inside, an invisible seam, a flat hem and an exact edge.

pieces.form: Long lean jacket with a natural shoulder
Slim straight trousers with a clean hem
Slim column dress with no trim
Crisp white shirt with a narrow collar
Fine, slim jumper with a clean neck
Long straight coat with a hidden placket

emotion.target_response: A calm, clear and confident feeling: the viewer sees nothing extra and trusts the cut.

avoid_when: the brief wants ornament, print or colour
the brief wants a historic or romantic costume
the brief wants a loud street look

modifiers.how: Keep the plain cut, and move to cashmere, loden and a warm neutral palette.
Keep the black and the plain surface, and widen the cut, drop the waist and leave an edge raw.
Keep the plain cloth, loosen the cut, and add a hood and a cap.
